sum_insured_options: ₹5L – ₹20L (based on sub-limit table; exact range not fully specified)

room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excludes suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount. If 'Cashless Discount' optional cover is opted, 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sub-limit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, gall bladder, spine, cancer, kidney, liver, infectious conditions.

deductible.note: No deductible in base plan. Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10,000–₹3,00,000 available as optional discount.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required. Reducible via portability/migration credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, calculi, organ transplant, hysterectomy, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is explicitly excluded (Code Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional 'Super Cumulative Bonus' can go up to 200% of SI.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per year or unlimited times per year. Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims. No inbuilt restoration.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list provided; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI; must exceed 3 days. Several conditions excluded: asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, vector-borne diseases, etc.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered up to In-patient SI; minimum 24-hour admission required.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Restoration not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to In-patient Hospitalisation SI; for emergency transfer and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to SI. Cumulative Bonus and Restoration not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Annexure II lists non-medical/consumable items as excluded. No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no look-back except fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly premium which has 15 days.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look at inception only; not applicable at renewal or porting.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, maternity excluded, no consumables cover, domiciliary excludes diabetes/hypertension/asthma/vector-borne

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus (up to 200%), Disease Sub-limits, Accidental Death Cover, Cashless Discount, No Claim Discount
